thread:
sara_support: FYI — AtlasCart escalation. They get intermittent JSON parse errors when using JSON mode + streaming + compressed responses. ~10% of responses arrive truncated. Sample attached below.

sara_support: sample raw response headers they captured:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Encoding: gzip
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Redwood-Request-Id: req_8f7a2c

<gzipped-bytes>
```

sara_support: after gunzip sometimes yields: `{"order": {"id": 123` (cut off) — other times it's fine.

kevin_se: Hosted or Dedicated? :thinking:

sara_support: Hosted (us-west-2). Model: gpt-open-3.0-ish. Customer rolled back their client from 1.4.3 -> 1.4.2 and the failures stopped. They said 1.4.3 enabled streaming+--compressed by default.

alok_engineer: Sounds like an issue with chunked+gzip handling in the response path (either our proxy or client plumbing). Any x-redwood-request-ids for bad vs good responses? Also can you paste the small hex/base64 tail of the gzipped payload when it fails?

sara_support: Bad example id above (req_8f7a2c). Customer also sent this minimal repro they used:
```
curl -H "Accept: application/json" --compressed -N "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?json_mode=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" | gunzip -c > out.json
# sometimes out.json is a truncated JSON file
```

maria_infra: I'll run a capture on staging with identical headers and HTTP/1.1 to reproduce. Assigning myself to capture raw TCP, upstream proxy logs, and our gzip filter.

alok_engineer: Quick workaround to give AtlasCart: ask them to disable client-side compression (remove --compressed or Accept-Encoding) or switch streaming off (stream=false) until we have a patch. We should also ask them to retry with node-fetch native decompression disabled to rule out client bug.

kevin_se: Customer impact = checkout failures so this is production affecting. Recommend escalation to P1 until repro confirmed. SLA: support reply within 2h, engineering ack within 4h. I can draft comms offering temporary workaround + we schedule a hotfix.

ops-bot: deploy notification — proxy-gzip-fix branch rolled to staging (not prod) at 1829123700

alok_engineer: I'm going to reproduce in staging and if confirmed we'll push a patch to sanitize chunk boundaries (we saw a past nginx config where a stray 0x00 could break gunzip). Expect update in ~3h.

sara_support: I told AtlasCart the workaround and asked for logs + their client version. They agree to disable --compressed for now. I'll send a status update once you confirm repro.

kevin_se: Good. Draft of customer message I'll send (short):
"Hi — thanks for the report. We're investigating a streaming+gzip edge case that can lead to truncated payloads for a small percentage of requests. Temporary workaround: disable client-side compression or disable streaming. We're treating this as high priority and will follow up within 3 hours with next steps. Apologies for the disruption." :thumbsup:

sara_support: ACK. I'll send that now and keep thread updated.
